branches.fallbackBehavior: No alternate feed or local stale-answer rejection exists in the configured Morpho oracle. EACAggregatorProxy delegates to its owner-selected aggregator. DualAggregator has caller-dependent primary/secondary round selection; its secondaryProxy is this same feed proxy, not a separate independent data source. No freshness SLA is asserted.

collateralParameters.note: Immutable market LLTV per Morpho marketById; this is loan-to-liquidation value, not a vault share mint cap.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Exact Morpho deployed runtime matches explorer source at block 24129914. Permissionless liquidate accrues interest, checks borrower health using IOracle.price and immutable LLTV, transfers seized collateral, and requires loan-token repayment; liquidator funding and realizable collateral value remain risks.
branches.backstop: No committed depositor loss backstop is established in the reviewed exact-vault disclosures. Galaxy Covered Vault terms section 3.6 warns depositors may lose some or all assets, section 9.3 disclaims a loss-prevention guarantee and section 10.2 caps contractual liability at USD 500. Circle Guarded Vaults terms dated September 15, 2026, section 2.1 explicitly creates no obligation to rescue or make whole a liquidity-provider, borrower or collateral position; section 3 states any Circle liquidity is not guaranteed. This is a reviewed absence of committed coverage in these governing public terms, not proof that no separate private agreement exists, and ordinary protocol liquidity or sentinel intervention is not insurance.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Exact Morpho liquidate writes off remaining borrow shares when borrower collateral becomes zero and subtracts badDebtAssets from totalSupplyAssets. The adapter values lender shares against that reduced supply book; VaultV2 accrual realizes losses. There is no local shutdown or guaranteed recovery payment in this Morpho market implementation.
